CustomField.description: API name of the autolaunched Flow that builds/updates the Opportunity during conversion. Resolved and invoked by the Form_Submission_Convert__e trigger; must be an active autolaunched Flow accepting a Form_Submission_Convert__e input. Blank uses the package's default Opportunity conversion Flow.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Advanced override: API name of the Flow that creates or updates an Opportunity on conversion. Leave blank to use the default Opportunity conversion Flow.
CustomField.label: FlowApiName (Opportunity)
